summary: Fix observed source-code defect: after a genuine already-submitted native draw a successful whole D3D9 ColorFill must retire old GPU source draw evidence rather than publish erased geometry. Preserve original game fallback. Reuse one exact D3D9 ARGB/X8 converter for native stereo eye full seed, chronological ColorFill and live native partial ColorFill. Actual game and HMD remain UNTESTED.

feature_contract.goal: Preserve authentic native game-frame color evidence and per-eye physical-alpha pixels across full D3D9 ColorFill, keeping DX9Ex fallback authoritative.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A full game ColorFill after a real native Draw retires the old source batch without presenting erased geometry.
Each native stereo-eye full seed and chronological ColorFill preserve X8 opaque and A8 source alpha semantics.
Previously submitted GPU bytes are not published after overwrite; original D3D9 output, input and FFB remain authoritative.
Mandatory Fast, Backend, Build, OpenXR and HUD Actions succeed on identical last material source SHA.

integration_path: real D3D9 ColorFill interception and native live game draw evidence
whole ColorFill source epoch retirement or partial in-place GPU replay
per-eye native source full color seed from physical X8/A8 provenance
native stereo chronological GPU fill and original D3D9 fallback

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: tools/dx11_native_full_colorfill_epoch_01044.cpp covers A8/X8 dual-eye alpha, source draw batch invalidation and scoped partial replay; final Windows build gate still required.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: The original D3D9 HRESULT, renderer, gamepad and FFB remain untouched; full overwrite after a Draw invalidates native publication rather than claiming a rendered frame.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Live native D3D9 ColorFill interceptor and shared native eye encoder use a common physical-alpha pixel conversion; stereo full source seed preserves per-eye surface format. Actual HMD producer linkage remains unproven.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native opt-in and source provenance remain fail-closed, original DX9Ex renderer/input/FFB authoritative and DXVK frozen.

ci_failure_repair: Initial Fast/Backend source SHA 4a47fd2 failed before source probes: previous 01043 run-record lacked new policy strategy fields and acceptance proof commands. Added authentic source-stage metadata, kept earlier validated SHA and truthful runtime status unchanged.
